P0_P6_preflight.launch_authority_note: PASS_ALPHA_PROOF only authorizes creation of a new frozen fresh prospective contract. It never itself launches, selects, promotes, or trades.

approval_bundle.approver: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)

N_effective_terminal_threshold.impact: Raw trades never treated as independent N. Existing controller has no approved numerical terminal N; no 100/200T invented.
N_effective_terminal_threshold.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
N_effective_terminal_threshold.proposal: N_effective=count(connected components of same-signal-window/shared-reviewed-shock graph). Approve terminal sample rule before observation; candidate power proposal N_min=ceil(((z_(1-alpha*/2)+z_(1-beta))*sigma_cluster/delta_min)^2), with sigma from approved DEV cluster estimator. Do not set N_min until alpha*, beta, delta_min and cluster authority are approved.
N_effective_terminal_threshold.units: clusters; sigma and delta same net effect units

W1_W2_W3_windows.impact: No authorized concrete dates/duration in prior draft; no windows created.
W1_W2_W3_windows.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
W1_W2_W3_windows.proposal: Before new outcomes approve UTC start S and duration L (native4h aligned): Wk=[S+(k-1)L,S+kL), k=1..3; entry attribution by signal-close time. Freeze candidate selection through W3. No retrospective endpoint selection.

initial_risk_R_denominator.impact: No SL order added. Requires authority to accept this statistical R in the existing net_r field; otherwise field remains unavailable.
initial_risk_R_denominator.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
initial_risk_R_denominator.proposal: Statistical volatility-normalized R only: d_i=10000*ATR20(signal_close_i)/entry_open_i; R_i=net_bps_i/d_i; NetR_W=sum(R_i). ATR20 uses completed native4h bars through signal close, Wilder seed=mean first20 true ranges; TR=max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)). Reject missing/nonpositive d_i. Freeze definition before new outcomes.
initial_risk_R_denominator.units: d_i trade-bps; R dimensionless; not an account-risk multiple or stop distance

market_shock_and_regime_owner.impact: No post-outcome winner/loser or final-MFE labels allowed as execution features; missing labels => unvalidated audit.
market_shock_and_regime_owner.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
market_shock_and_regime_owner.proposal: Source owner must supply causal regime_id, market_shock_id, availability_ts<=decision_ts, method/code/source hashes. Existing independence() groups same signal timestamp, then merges groups connected by any common reviewed shock ID.

minimum_economic_effect.impact: No unseen results used to pick delta; candidate-specific value absent.
minimum_economic_effect.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
minimum_economic_effect.proposal: Approve delta_min>0 in mean net trade-bps per independent cluster (and paired baseline if incremental claim); test lower confidence bound>delta_min while retaining every existing absolute window gate.

protective_SL_operating_contract.impact: Statistical denominator cannot satisfy an operating SL requirement.
protective_SL_operating_contract.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
protective_SL_operating_contract.proposal: Retain initial_protective_sl=null. Approver must determine whether the formal lane permits a no-SL candidate. If actual protective SL required, KR3 is inapplicable and a separately authorized strategy-change experiment is necessary.

purge_embargo_runoff.impact: 96h is a proposed conservative data-separation rule derived from existing cap; not approved window policy. Gaps cannot be filled or forced liquidated.
purge_embargo_runoff.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
purge_embargo_runoff.proposal: For each fold, purge any fitting label interval [entry_ts,max_possible_exit_ts] intersecting evaluation label intervals. Conservative embargo E=24*4h=96h inherited maximum horizon, plus observed next-open delay if later. Stop new evaluation entries at right edge minus approved max horizon/delay; carry existing positions to observed exit within authorized runoff, otherwise censored_open remains nonzero. Warmup past bars is feature-only.

retention_denominator_baseline.impact: Requires explicit baseline/calendar and all-winner versus ordinary/large-window acceptance. Existing 60% formal gate preserved, never substituted with DEV ratio.
retention_denominator_baseline.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
retention_denominator_baseline.proposal: Use frozen KR1_FULL matching origin set B with closed parent net b_i>0: D=sum_B b_i; retention=100*sum_B min(b_i,max(0,child_closed_net_i))/D. Missing child contributes zero retained profit, never a zero-return trade. Child still open gives lower bound above and upper bound adding b_i; D=0 -> unavailable. Report all parent winners; separately preserve existing top-decile/ordinary DEV diagnostics.

review_schedule_multiple_testing.impact: Preserve historical candidate multiplicity; new filename is not a fresh testing family.
review_schedule_multiple_testing.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
review_schedule_multiple_testing.proposal: Freeze one terminal look after W3 and complete authorized runoff. T6/T12 are existing continuation reviews, never terminal claims. If K economic claims are authorized, preallocate familywise alpha across claims (e.g. alpha*=alpha/K) and use no unscheduled efficacy looks. Approve alpha,beta,K and sequential error spending if any early efficacy look is wanted.

source_specific_stale_authority.impact: Historical receipt freshness is never inferred from recent file timestamps.
source_specific_stale_authority.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
source_specific_stale_authority.proposal: For each concrete source approve threshold T_source in ms and source clock/availability semantics; freshness=0<=as_of_ms-last_verified_source_close_ms<T_source; missing approval fails closed.

threshold_authority.impact: Shared thresholds unchanged; a code owner is not evidence of a human approval.
threshold_authority.owner: backend/research/rebuild/g5_g14_generation_controller_v1.py; explicit KR3 candidate formal-contract approver (not identified in supplied authority)
threshold_authority.proposal: Bind the exact shared contract digest and existing economic_window_thresholds/integrity_equals to KR3; approve only missing candidate-specific units, baselines, windows, effective N and testing policy.
